prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Make ONE targeted revision of the first supplied portrait, retaining this exact recognizable OSIN: balding broad-headed male workshop foreman in his forties, thick straight eyebrows, broad nose, square cheeks/jaw, compact dark beard, matte brown riveted leather apron and olive-gray shirt. Image 1 is the edit target; image 2 is his old identity only; remaining images are approved style anchors, not other subjects. Current written card details remain authoritative.
Required changes:
1. Replace the conspicuous pale eye-white bars with tiny LOW-LUMINANCE DARK TAUPE/OCHRE-GRAY SLIVERS, only 1-2 logical pixels on a 74x100 grid, close to the cheek shadow brightness. No white, cream, sparkle or bright catchlight. Keep pupils and dark lids crisp so his gaze is readable.
2. Convert beard and side hair into THREE OR FOUR LARGE CONNECTED DARK BROWN MASSES with just broad stepped face-defining highlights. Remove ALL narrow diagonal streaks, parallel beard strands, scribble/hatching, little highlights and isolated speckle. A dense solid compact beard silhouette, not individual hairs.
3. Move beard chin down to y=87 on a 74x100 logical canvas by making the FACE and jaw slightly taller, and shorten the bare neck dramatically. The combined visible neck + shirt collar + apron edge must occupy ONLY THE BOTTOM 8-12 logical pixels. Keep one dull apron rivet; remove the second if necessary. Absolutely no chest or shoulders. Do not shrink the head.
4. Keep thick brows assertive and inner brows roughly level, one OUTER brow subtly raised. Firm closed mouth, blunt focused appraisal. Do not turn him into worried, grieving or enraged.
Keep full crown and ear within 3px safe margins; this remains an extremely close adult HEAD portrait at 74:100 ratio. Cheekbone/nose/jaw shading is large hard-edged polygons and chunky 2-8 pixel clusters, not painterly texture. Keep the existing mature bald identity and color family. No smooth gradients, blur, dithering, fine wrinkle noise, antialiasing, text, frame, new props or decorative marks. Use at most 32 matte earth colors. True transparent background. The image must read as strongly designed chunky pixel art at 74x100, not a high-resolution pixelated painting.
